senses.gloss: f. (preced.) secrecy; בצ׳ privately, in secret, without ostentation.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 12b:19">M. Kat. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ובלבד שיכניסם בצ׳ וכ׳</he> provided he brings them into his house with the least publicity possible.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 12b:21">Ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ דהני יממא הוא</he> the least publicity in bringing these (joists) in is, if it is done in day-time.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 24a:16">M. Kat. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>דברים שבצ׳ נוהג</he> one must observe (on Sabbaths or festive days) such customs of mourning as refer to domestic privacy; <cite ref="Ketubot 4a:7">Keth. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>דברים של צ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Beitzah 16a:10">Bets. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מצות … בצ׳ וכ׳</he> all commands that God gave to Israel, he gave unto them publicly (for all nations), except the Sabbath which he gave them privately, as we read, between me and &c. (<cite ref="Exodus 31:17">Ex. XXXI, 17</cite>); a. fr.
